title: Kraft Heinz Spurned in $143 Billion Unilever Takeover Bid
主要内容: Kraft Heinz Co. made a $143 billion offer for Unilever in what would be the largest-ever takeover in the food or beverage industry, opening a campaign to create a consumer-goods giant with household names from Dove soap to Heinz ketchup. Unilever said Friday it rejected the $50 a share proposal, comprising about two-thirds in cash and a third in new stock. The approach 'fundamentally undervalues' the company, Unilever said, adding that it doesn’t see a basis for further discussions.
